metadata.description: Gradual and antiphoner, Corbie or Noyon, 10th century; private collection (château du Mont-Renaud, near Noyon). French neumes without a staff, added by a notator later than the text scribe. The gradual of St Agnes, f. 9v. The original is not online: the folio is the facsimile in Paléographie musicale XVI (1955).
metadata.title: Antiphonaire du Mont-Renaud
metadata.transcription: Read sign by sign from the Internet Archive scan of Paléographie musicale XVI (item palographiemusic16macq, image 0106, cut to f. 9v and turned upright) by two independent readers, October 2026; the neumes assigned to syllables by aligning them with St Gall 339; see research/diffusa-est/staff-readings/README.md.
